args.prompt:
Decide whether the EVIDENCE supports the CLAIM. Judge only the evidence text; ignore your own knowledge.
EXPLICIT = the evidence directly states the claim.
IMPLICIT = the evidence clearly implies the claim without stating it.
NONE = the evidence only mentions the subject, or does not support the claim.
CLAIM: "Nueva Pompeya" is worth visiting for travellers interested in history.
EVIDENCE: """Barracas, Parque Patricios and Nueva Pompeya are three neighborhoods that have had a very different development to the “historic” south that stretches between Plaza de Mayo and La Boca. This “other south”, less picturesque, more fragmented, away from the touristic spots, preserves in its streets a shadow of that old industrial Buenos Aires of the early twentieth century: an area which was eventually taken over by working class neighborhoods and where much of the social housing built throughout the 20th century was put up."""
Reply with one JSON object: {"level":"EXPLICIT|IMPLICIT|NONE","rationale":"<one sentence>"}
